method.global_four_metrics: Inherited accepted original float32 evaluator values; no redundant evaluator or model execution
method.absolute_difference: Shuffle minus route-specific Normal, native metric units; percentage points multiply by100
method.user_pairing: Exact trusted sample_key+target Counter, exact same set and four-code targets within each domain/route
method.ranking: Original saved model-returned order; scores checked nonincreasing and duplicate candidates absent; no candidate rescoring/reordering
method.list_comparison: Top1 equality, ordered10 equality, set equality, intersection/Jaccard, positional and common-candidate rank changes; sets are descriptive only
method.target_absent: Rank null/transition index0 when target is absent from original Top10
method.prespecified_examples_rule: Before new results: largest number of changed original list positions, then smallest Top10 intersection, then sample_key ascending; retain first three. Separately first three lost/gained@10 by sample_key. No support-for-hypothesis selection.
method.scope: Within-domain/route Normal→Shuffle only; no A/B same-model, multi-seed, significance or strict permutation-invariance claim

independent_review_of_this_new_analysis: Required from a different actual agent; this author does not self-sign nonauthor acceptance.
